T: Tough ain't enough. Lemon pie helps.
D: A determined waitress talks a grizzled boxing trainer into taking her on.
P: Serve dessert when Frankie and Maggie stop at the roadside diner for lemon pie.
S: Maggie wrapping up steak left on customers' plates
Rump steak seared hard, rested, cut into bite-sized pieces and tossed in garlic butter, served on toothpicks with a little horseradish.
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter mixed briefly, baked in a hot cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes, honey butter.
M: the diner where Maggie waits tables
Rump steak seared to medium-rare, rested, with two fried eggs, hash browns and buttered toast.
the training diet in the gym
Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, over steamed rice with broccoli and a squeeze of lemon.
W: the real lemon pie at the roadside diner Frankie loves
Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with a lemon curd of lemon juice, zest, sugar, cornflour, yolks and butter, topped with a tall Italian meringue, browned at 200C for 6 minutes.
K: the late drive back from the diner
Strong drip coffee poured black into thick mugs and refilled without asking.

s.note: Maggie wrapping up steak left on customers' plates
s.how: Season 500g rump steak and sear hard in a very hot pan for 3 minutes a side. Rest for 5 minutes, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Toss in melted butter with crushed garlic and sea salt. Serve on toothpicks with a small bowl of horseradish.

Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, an egg, 300ml buttermilk and 50g melted butter until just combined. Pour into a hot greased cast iron pan and bake at 220C for 20 minutes. Beat softened butter with honey and serve with warm wedges.

m.note: the diner where Maggie waits tables
m.how: Grate 600g potatoes, squeeze dry and fry as hash brown cakes in butter until crisp. Season 4 rump steaks with cracked pepper and sear to medium-rare, then rest. Fry 8 eggs. Serve each steak with two eggs, hash browns and buttered toast.

w.note: the real lemon pie at the roadside diner Frankie loves
w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case. Whisk the juice and zest of 4 lemons, 200g sugar, 4 tbsp cornflour, 4 yolks and 60g butter over heat until thick, then pour in. Whisk the whites with 150g sugar to stiff glossy peaks, pile on top and bake at 200C for 6 minutes.

d.note: the late drive back from the diner
d.how: Brew a big pot of strong drip coffee from freshly ground beans. Pour into thick diner mugs and keep the pot on the warmer. When a mug gets low, top it up without asking, the way a good diner always does.
